envelope.description: Recover interrupted work and admit approved full restarts

body.title: Recover interrupted work and admit approved full restarts
body.summary: Add coordinator recover admission using existing main-owner job/subject serialization. Persist exact actionId replay and dispatch reservations before short acknowledgement; reconstruct accepted plan/chunks and execute only unfinished work. Bind trusted recovering controller after old execution ends; append fresh user-approved invalidated-attempt restart with no reuse and current workflow-aware subject preparation.
acceptanceChecks: Explicit unchanged-subject resume retains accepted chunks byte-for-byte, skips accepted planning/units and re-consolidates all-complete report-only work with zero provider calls.

Exact action replay never duplicates work; conflicting actions, missing checkpoints/attempts, foreign active owners and stale generations are refused. Startup/progress/duplicate start never implicitly recover.

Approved restart_full appends the next fresh attempt and freezes previous history; admitted same-attempt references ignore external changes, while fresh restart derives proper Epic/Standalone/Issue prerequisites and reviewer party.

tests.name: Explicit unchanged-subject recovery skips accepted plan/chunks and completes report-only work without model calls.
Recovery action replay/conflicts, missing checkpoints, controller rebind and fresh approved restart preserve authority, history and workflow context.
